patch_description: This crossover combines the current staged-funnel architecture (vectorized softmin gradient ascent → exact hill-climb polish → basin hopping → final polish) with the strongest features of the top-performing prior variant: the expanded deterministic seed library (double-ring configurations across multiple radii, 3-fold symmetric orbits, jittered lattices, seeded random restarts), elite selection (top-14 candidates polished with per-rank deterministic seeds), a multi-elite basin-hopping stage with an amplitude ladder, hull-expansion probes, and a longer final polish. From the hexagon-based inspiration we add dual-ring hexagonal seeds (6+6 rings + center at varying radii), which historically produce good Heilbronn basins. The result should recover the ~0.84 combined-score behavior while remaining fully deterministic and reasonably fast.
